extraction_notes: MM1Z2V7 electrical-characteristics row: VZ minimum 2.5 V, nominal 2.7 V, maximum 2.9 V; IZT = 5 mA; maximum ZZT = 110 ohm at IZT; maximum IR = 120 microA at VR = 1 V; Ta = 25 degC unless otherwise noted.
The schema has no nominal source_kind, so the nominal VZ and its IZT test current are represented as typical while the min/max VZ values are retained in this note.
Maximum ratings also publish PD = 500 mW, VF maximum 0.9 V at IF = 10 mA, Tj and Tstg = -55 to +150 degC, and typical RthetaJ-A = 340 degC/W.
The MM1Z2V7 curve points were digitized from the labeled 2V7 curve in Fig. 1; the plotted axes are VZ in V and IZ in mA, converted here to SI amperes for the y values.
No diode capacitance, reverse-recovery specification, or ZZK/IZK knee-impedance pair is published in the supplied datasheet; those schema fields are null where applicable.
